name: Burp Suite MCP Server
description: Exposes Burp Suite's REST API to AI assistants, enabling users to trigger vulnerability scans, monitor progress, and manage security tasks through natural language. It also provides programmatic access to Burp's security knowledge base for querying vulnerability definitions and remediation advice.
